predecessors.name: Kingdom of Alba
predecessors.text: the same kingdom under its earlier Cliopatria name: the Kingdom of Scotland page dates it 'traditionally said to have been founded in 843' and gives one infobox 843-1707; Cliopatria's Kingdom of Alba…

successors.name: Kingdom of Great Britain
successors.text: 'political union with England as the Kingdom of Great Britain, which came into force on 1 May 1707'

ledger.x: 1294: the Kingdom of Scotland (Cliopatria's name for the kingdom of Alba from 1294).

Page silent on the start: the Hebrides came to Scotland by the 1266 Treaty of Perth (Kingdom of Scotland page) but 'Successive Lords of the Isles fiercely asserted their independence from Scotland' and 'the island chiefs remained functionally independent for many centuries' (Lordship of the Isles page).
1296: Edward I invades Scotland.
1296: Balliol is deposed.
1296: England occupies Scotland (July).
1297: the Scots clear the English out after Stirling Bridge (11 September), leaving only Dundee Castle in English hands.
1298: Edward I returns and beats Wallace at Falkirk (22 July).
1304: the Scots submit.
1304: England again rules Scotland.
1306: Robert Bruce is crowned King of Scots at Scone (25 March).
1313: Bruce takes the Isle of Man.
1314: Bannockburn ends the English occupation.
1314: the English retake the Isle of Man.
1317: the Scots retake the Isle of Man.
1318: Berwick falls and the Borders war begins.
1318: the Scots take Berwick.
1328: the Treaty of Edinburgh-Northampton recognises Scottish independence (1 May).
1333: the Scots lose the Isle of Man.
1333: the island passes back and forth.
1346: the English take the Isle of Man for the last time.
1452: the capital moves from Dunfermline to Edinburgh.
1472: Scotland annexes Orkney and Shetland.
1482: Berwick falls to the English for the last time.
1493: the Lordship of the Isles is forfeit.
1552: the Debatable Lands are divided.
1650: Cromwell invades Scotland (22 July).
1651: the central Lowlands fall to the Commonwealth.
1652: the last Scottish strongholds surrender.
1652: Scotland is conquered and, from 1653, incorporated in the Commonwealth.
1660: Scotland leaves the Commonwealth with the Restoration of Charles II.
1707: the Kingdom of Scotland unites with England as Great Britain (1 May).

wars.name: First War of Scottish Independence
wars.outcome: Scottish victory: Balliol deposed 1296, Stirling Bridge 1297, Falkirk 1298, submission 1304, Bruce crowned 1306, Bannockburn 1314, and the Treaty of Edinburgh-Northampton of 1 May 1328 recognises independence.

wars.name: Struggle for the Isle of Man
wars.outcome: The island changed hands in 1313 (Scots), 1314 (English), 1317 (Scots), 1333 (English, then 'back and forth') and passed to the English 'for the last time in 1346'.

wars.name: Anglo-Scottish War (Third English Civil War)
wars.outcome: Commonwealth victory: Dunbar (3 September 1650), Worcester (3 September 1651), Dundee (1 September 1651), Dunnottar (24 May 1652); Scotland incorporated in the Commonwealth.

certainty.note: War, occupation and reconquest; the English border moved with Berwick and the Borders campaigns.

The border with England was fixed 'close to the modern border' by the Treaty of York (1237); exceptions: Berwick (changing hands, English again in 1482), the Debatable Lands (no border until 1552) and the Hebrides under the Lords of the…
The Scots' Dike of 1552 closes the last undefined stretch of the English border; Orkney and Shetland are island coasts.
